Narada thought he was God's greatest devotee, until Krishna pointed at a farmer. Stay till the end, because the test will surprise you.

As the story goes, Narada chanted Narayana all day, every day. One day he asked, Lord, who loves you the most? Krishna smiled, and showed him a poor farmer, who said God's name just three times a day. Narada laughed. Only three times?

So Krishna gave him a test. Carry this pot full of oil around the whole city, and don't spill a single drop. Narada walked slowly, eyes glued to the pot. He came back proud. Not one drop spilled. Wait, then why was Krishna smiling?
How many times did you think of me on the way? Narada went silent. Not even once. The farmer carried a family and his fields every day, and still remembered God three times.
That's why a small prayer every day matters. Comment Narayana, and send this to someone who is always busy.
